description: This file defines the IPlacementContext interface in the Orleans.Runtime.Placement namespace, providing methods and properties related to grain placement and silo information within the Orleans distributed system.

classes.name: IPlacementContext
classes.description: An interface providing context for grain placement operations, including methods to retrieve compatible silos and silo information.

methods.name: GetCompatibleSilos
methods.description: Returns an array of silos compatible with the specified placement target.

methods.name: GetCompatibleSilosWithVersions
methods.description: Returns a read-only dictionary mapping grain interface versions to arrays of compatible silo addresses.
